title: Gitignore Check
summary: Runs Git's real ignore rules against your files so a .gitignore that only looks right doesn't let secrets or node_modules into a commit.
description: Dependency-free .gitignore checker that applies Git's matching rules to your file list, names the line deciding each file, and flags syntax traps, ineffective ! lines, anchors that miss nested folders, missing .env/key/node_modules entries and already-tracked files.
catches: Inline # comments, trailing tabs, leading spaces, backslashes and ./ that change a pattern
! lines that can't re-include a file under an excluded folder, or are overridden later
Leading / anchors that miss nested folders
.env, private keys or node_modules not ignored
Already-committed files .gitignore won't untrack, with the git rm --cached command
limits: Checks only the one .gitignore and file list you paste; nested .gitignore, .git/info/exclude and global excludes are not read
Reimplements Git's rules in JS; edge cases may differ from your Git version
Does not scan file contents for secrets
a11y: Text areas have labels; the editor has aria-invalid when errors exist and is described by the status
Result summary uses role=status; icons are aria-hidden
Each issue has a button to select its line, and focus returns to a sensible control after a fix
